title: Pipewright environment manifest (written by the platform side, read by the ML side)

environment.description: The environment's name, as `--env` names it (for example dev or prod)

blueprint.description: The platform blueprint that wrote this manifest, optionally with its version (poc is the starter; private-managed and private-gke are Pipewright Enterprise)

orchestrator.description: Where pipelines run: vertex (Vertex AI Pipelines, the default) or kfp (Kubeflow Pipelines on the environment's GKE cluster)

project.description: The Google Cloud project the environment's resources live in

region.description: The region pipelines, models, endpoints and buckets use

artifact_registry.description: The Artifact Registry repositories release pushes to

docker.description: The Docker repository for component, Ray and serving images (<region>-docker.pkg.dev/<project>/<repo>)

kfp.description: The Kubeflow Pipelines repository for compiled pipeline templates (https://<region>-kfp.pkg.dev/<project>/<repo>)

python.description: A Python package repository, when the platform offers one for the use cases' requirements

artifacts_bucket.description: The bucket for pipeline roots, release contracts, approved model files and online store exports, with a prefix per tenant

landing_bucket.description: The bucket data files land in; a file under a tenant's landing prefix starts the use case's landing trigger

launcher.description: The launcher: the platform's service that starts runs from landing files, schedules and requests, as the tenant's runner

url.description: The launcher's URL, for direct requests (`pipewright run` without a run requests topic) and for `doctor` to check the subscription

service.description: The launcher's Cloud Run service name, checked by `doctor`

service_account.description: The identity the launcher runs as; it submits each run as the tenant's runner

subscription.description: The Pub/Sub subscription that delivers landing and run events to the launcher, checked by `doctor`

run_requests_topic.description: Pub/Sub topic for run requests from inside the perimeter (pushed to the launcher's /pubsub/run); used instead of calling /run when set

runtime.description: cloud_run (default): the launcher is a Cloud Run service fed by push subscriptions; gke: a Deployment in the cluster (private-gke) that pulls the same subscriptions

audiences.description: every name the launcher answers to (ID token audiences): its Cloud Run URL and its name in the cluster, so releases built under either runtime keep working

renewer_job.description:
Pipewright 1.4.1: the lock renewer's Cloud Run job (projects/

/locations//jobs/), a separate identity from the launcher

renewer_service_account.description: Pipewright 1.4.1: the renewer's service account (get, setRetention and update on the model folders and contracts only)

image.description: the launcher image by digest; Pipewright FR-57: an A/B test's router-only gateway runs it where no online store names a lookup image

ai.description: AI build assistance (Pipewright 1.3.0): whether coding agents may use Pipewright's tools against this environment.

local_tools.description: allowed (the default): `pipewright mcp` and `pipewright context build` run against this environment; forbidden: they refuse (for example in production).

data_classes.description: What may reach an agent's model in this environment, beyond the fixed rules (rows never). Set by the platform (Pipewright Enterprise).

offline.description: true: no live tools; agents work from the manifest, the repository and the context pack only.

deny_names.description: Table and column names withheld from agents, as case-insensitive patterns (*customer_ssn*). The tools leave them out and say how many were withheld.

aggregates.description: Aggregates (counts per value, null rates, min and max) for the `profile` tool; served only by Enterprise's hosted tool server.

allowed.description: Whether the tool server may return aggregates; false (the default) refuses them

min_group_size.description: Groups smaller than this are suppressed.

certified_agents.description: The coding agents certified for this environment (informational: the context pack and the review bundle name them).

approved_models.description: The model endpoints agents may use with this environment (informational, recorded for evidence).

policies.description: The platform's rules for every use case in this environment; `validate`, `release` and the commands that act on models enforce them

registration.description: 1.4.3 (FR-100): who writes the model registry. runner (default): each run's runner uploads its version. launcher: runners cannot write the registry; the launcher registers each version after checking the run, its files and the gates, and moves the default only by the release's policy

ab_test.description: Pipewright FR-57: the platform's rules for A/B tests in this environment

allowed.description: false refuses every A/B test here (default allowed)

required_approvers.description: approver groups every test's decision needs, such as model-risk

max_treatment_bp.description: the largest treatment share a test may have, in basis points

min_days.description: the shortest ab_test.duration.min_days a test may set

feed_exposures.description: true lets ab_test.publish.exposures copy per-unit lines (pseudonymised) to the tenant's feed; default false

overlap.description: another use case's active test on the same unit at a test's start: allow (default), warn (recorded on the test), refuse

required_guardrails.description: business guardrails every A/B test must declare, by name (such as complaints)

evaluation.description: Evaluation rules every use case in this environment must meet (Pipewright 1.3.0).

min_gates.description: The least each metric's gate may ask, by metric: a number (a minimum) or {min, max}. A use case without such a gate, or with a weaker one, is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A metric every use case must gate on: a number is the least it may be set to (a floor for a higher-is-better metric), or {min, max} bounds for the gate's threshold

batch_scoring.description: Pipewright 1.4.3 (FR-130). manual: every scoring run in this environment waits for a person (approvals.batch_scoring manual for every use case; a use case may not set auto); auto or unset: each use case decides

deploy_model.description: manual: use cases may not deploy without a person (auto and on_register refused); ci (Pipewright 1.2.0): only through a GitHub-approved gate (approvals.deploy_model ci)

promote_model.description: Whether a model promoted into this environment needs a person to approve it there (manual, the default) or becomes the default as it arrives (auto)

retraining.description: platform limits on retrain decisions in this environment

allowed_modes.description: The retraining.mode values use cases may set here (off, candidate, deploy, ...); others are refused by validate

required_approvers.description: approver groups every use case must include (e.g. model risk)

max_snooze_days.description: The longest a retrain proposal may be snoozed; retraining.snooze.max_days above it is refused

bqml.description: platform limits on BigQuery ML use cases in this environment (validate enforces them)

max_bytes_billed.description: the most bytes one BigQuery ML job may bill; the default limit when a use case sets none

allowed_model_types.description: The BigQuery ML model types use cases may train here (for example LOGISTIC_REG, BOOSTED_TREE_CLASSIFIER, KMEANS, ARIMA_PLUS)

ai_forecast.description: allow bqml.forecast.engine ai_forecast (AI.FORECAST with Google's TimesFM model), the one exception to C-08; off unless true (Pipewright 1.1)

images.description: approved image allow-list (Pipewright 1.1): the base images and package indexes a use case's images may be built from; validate and release refuse anything else

base_images.description: patterns (fnmatch) every base image must match: component, Ray and synthetic images

package_indexes.description: the pip indexes requirement files may name; the first is used when a file names none; direct references are refused

default_base_image.description: the base of the component and synthetic images instead of python:3.11-slim (for example a mirror)

accelerators.description: accelerators use cases may ask for (Pipewright 1.2.0): steps (steps.<name>.gpu; without it any, as in 1.x) and serving (model.serving.accelerator; without it none)

steps.description: GPUs pipeline steps may ask for (steps.<name>.gpu)

types.description: The accelerator types allowed for steps (for example NVIDIA_TESLA_T4, NVIDIA_L4)

max_count.description: The most accelerators one step may ask for

serving.description: GPUs a serving deployment may ask for (model.serving.accelerator)

types.description: The accelerator types allowed for serving

max_count.description: The most accelerators one serving replica may ask for

synthetic.description: platform limits on synthetic data in this environment (validate enforces them)

allowed.description: false: no use case may switch synthetic data on here

allowed_purposes.description: The synthetic.purpose values use cases may declare here

allowed_engines.description: The synthetic data engines use cases may use here

differential_privacy_for.description: purposes whose every candidate must train with differential privacy

gates.description: floors: a use case's gate is raised to this when it is looser (quality gates too)

additionalProperties.description: A gate every synthetic data run must pass here, by metric name: one bound, min or max

min.description: The least the metric may be

max.description: The most the metric may be

required_approvers.description: approver groups that must approve a synthetic release before it leaves (Pipewright Enterprise)

serving.description: Pipewright 1.4.2: rules for shared serving pools in this environment; 1.4.3 (FR-98): capture, health and scale to zero

capture.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): whether use cases may record what their endpoints receive and answer, and the limits

health.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): required: every use case that serves must have monitoring.health on

scale_to_zero.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): refused: no use case may set model.serving.scale_to_zero (an Agent Platform Preview that drops calls while it scales up)

pools.description: Rules for shared deployment resource pools: in production at least two machines (min_replicas) and no Preview serving images unless allow_preview

allow_preview.description: PyTorch co-hosting (a Google Preview): allowed by default outside production (an environment whose name has prod), refused in production unless true

min_replicas.description: the fewest machines a pool may have (default 2 in production, 1 elsewhere)

settle_seconds.description: after a change to a pool, how long Pipewright waits for its machines to finish restarting before announcing it settled and letting the next change run (default 360)

integrity.description: Pipewright 1.4.0: what runs is what was approved. Deploy and promote compare the version with its approval (the evaluation record, the model files and the serving image, or a BigQuery ML model), and approvals are judged by the released rules.

mode.description: refuse (the default): a version that is not the one approved is not deployed or promoted; warn: said, and it goes on.

lock.description: Lock the approved files with Cloud Storage object retention (the artifacts bucket needs object retention enabled).

days.description: How many days each approved file is retained (0, the default, locks nothing); the renewer extends it while the version is live

mode.description: locked: nobody can shorten or remove it, not even an owner.

renew.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-101): while a version is in use (a default, serving, or the rollback candidate) the renewer keeps its approved files locked lock.days ahead; a retired version keeps its last date.

rollback_days.description: Pipewright 1.4.1: how long the previous default stays protected as the rollback candidate after it is replaced (default lock.days; 0: no rollback window, serving versions stay protected).

inference.description: A scoring run whose default version has no approval: off (as before), warn (the launcher logs it) or refuse (the run is not submitted).

until.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-102): with mode warn, the last day the override applies; afterwards the policy is refuse again on its own. The override is recorded and alerted while it lasts.

reason.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-102): why mode is warn (recorded with who set it and until when).

pin.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-101): scoring runs (with inference warn or refuse) and KServe use the approved file generations, each checked by SHA-256 before use, not the live model folder. off: as before.

watch.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-101): the launcher re-checks every default and serving version against its approval and records model.integrity when the result changes (alerts sync alerts on it).

watch_every.description: Pipewright 1.4.1: how often the watch runs, on the launcher's hourly tick: 1h, 6h, 1d.

features.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-103): feature definitions checked against the feature contract and the approval. All off by default.

check.description: a changed definition is an integrity problem, judged by policies.integrity.mode

built_tables.description: tables built by a query: the SQL of the job that last wrote them (needs bigquery.jobs.listAll)

record_reads.description: scoring runs record the base tables they read and when

fingerprint_rows.description: and a row fingerprint per source (one full scan each)

snapshot_days.description: and an immutable snapshot of each base table, kept this many days

tenants.description: The teams that use this environment, by tenant name: each has its own runner identity, BigQuery dataset, landing prefix and artifact prefixes

additionalProperties.description: One tenant's resources; a use case names its tenant in spec.tenant

ab_test_feed.description: Pipewright FR-57: the tenant's A/B feed for its own tools (ab_test.publish)

topic.description: the Pub/Sub topic the test's events (and allowed exposures) are copied to

key_secret.description:
the Secret Manager secret (projects/

/secrets/) whose value keys the pseudonymised unit in feed exposures

agent_service_account.description: AI build assistance (Pipewright 1.3.0): the service account a coding agent and `pipewright mcp` act as for this tenant, impersonated by the team's engineers, with metadata-only roles. Left out, the tools use the person's own credentials.

agent_server.description: AI build assistance: the tenant's hosted tool server (Pipewright Enterprise), reached through `gcloud run services proxy` or `kubectl port-forward`; `pipewright mcp --print-config` prints the settings.

runtime.description: Where it runs: cloud_run or gke

service.description: Its Cloud Run service or Kubernetes service name

service_account.description: The server's own identity (metadata only; writes the audit).

runner_service_account.description: The identity the tenant's pipeline runs, scoring and syncs run as; it reads only the tenant's own data and prefixes

bigquery_dataset.description: The tenant's BigQuery dataset for its use cases' tables, predictions and BigQuery ML models

landing_prefix.description: The tenant's prefix in the landing bucket; files under it start its use cases' landing triggers

online_serving.description: Whether the tenant may serve with online features (model.serving.features online): the platform has granted its runner the online store's read access

namespace.description: The tenant's Kubernetes namespace for pipelines on GKE (orchestrator kfp)

outputs_uri.description: where use cases of this tenant may write GCS outputs (ends with /)

decision_feed.description: subscription with this tenant's retrain decision events (use cases opt in with retraining.decisions.publish)

kubernetes_service_account.description: orchestrator kfp: the Kubernetes service account this tenant's runs and Ray clusters use (Workload Identity binds it to the runner)

ray.description: this tenant's Ray settings, over the environment's

loop_production_project.description: the closed retrain loop (Pipewright 1.4.0): the production project whose data this tenant's loop training runs may read (retraining.loop.data: production); the launcher accepts production's feature and label tables only there

features.description: the feature datasets this tenant's use cases may read (data.features_from)

observability.description: Where Pipewright's events and evidence go: the events topic, the evidence dataset and location, log sinks

incidents_channel.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): the Cloud Monitoring notification channel (Pub/Sub) health policies notify; the launcher turns its incidents into serving.degraded and serving.recovered

events_topic.description: Pub/Sub topic for Pipewright lifecycle events

log_sinks.description: informational: where the platform routes logs (e.g. dynatrace)

otlp_endpoint.description: Reserved for an OpenTelemetry collector; not read by this version

evidence_dataset.description: BigQuery dataset with lifecycle events and audit logs (evidence packs)

evidence_uri.description: write-once location for evidence packs (ends with /)

log_bucket.description: Pipewright FR-57: the Cloud Logging bucket the platform routes the project's logs into (instead of _Default); the launcher reads the A/B gateway's lines there

audit_log_bucket.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-102): a Cloud Logging bucket with locked retention that keeps Admin Activity entries for Agent Platform and the artifacts bucket longer than 400 days; the approval cross-check reads it

audit_retention_days.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-102): how long audit_log_bucket keeps entries (regulated models often serve for years)

data_write_logs.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-102): Cloud Storage DATA_WRITE audit logs are on (with an exclusion keeping only the artifacts bucket's model folders), so lineage and the alerts can name who wrote a file

security.description: private profiles: applied by Pipewright to every pipeline job, model and endpoint it creates

kms_key.description: CMEK key for pipeline jobs, models and endpoints

network.description: VPC that pipeline jobs peer with (projects/<number>/global/networks/<name>)

reserved_ip_ranges.description: Private Services Access ranges for pipeline jobs

perimeter.description: informational: the VPC Service Controls perimeter

bigquery_kms_key.description: CMEK key for BigQuery query results (required when the CMEK organization policy covers BigQuery)

approver_groups.description: registered approver groups: a member approves by publishing to the group's topic, so IAM on the topic decides who belongs (any Google group, user or service account)

additionalProperties.description: One approver group, by the name use cases list in their required approvers

topic.description: The group's Pub/Sub topic: whoever may publish to it is a member

description.description: What the group is for, shown to approvers

ray.description: Ray on Vertex AI for use cases with Ray steps: the clusters' network, images and limits

features.description: Feature tables and the online stores this environment offers

requires.description: the Pipewright versions this manifest needs, as a version specifier (for example ">=0.5"); older versions refuse it with a clear message

kubernetes.description: orchestrator kfp (private-gke): the GKE cluster's Kubernetes API, called as the caller's Google identity

dns_endpoint.description: the cluster's DNS endpoint (a host name, IAM authorized): for callers outside the VPC, such as a Fleet View collector

ca_certificate.description: the cluster's CA certificate, base64 PEM

namespace.description: where Kubeflow Pipelines runs and Ray clusters run

cluster.description: the GKE cluster's resource name (evidence reads its node disk keys, secrets key and network)

schedules.description: where use cases' schedules (triggers.schedules) run; without it: Cloud Scheduler jobs that call the launcher

backend.description: cloud_scheduler: a Cloud Scheduler job per schedule; kubernetes: a CronJob per schedule in the cluster (private-gke), which publishes the run request to launcher.run_requests_topic

namespace.description: kubernetes: the namespace for the CronJobs (only the scheduler's service account is there)

service_account.description: kubernetes: the Kubernetes service account the CronJobs run as (bound to an identity that may only publish run requests)

image.description: kubernetes: the image the CronJobs run (one with Pipewright: the launcher image), pinned by digest

run_as_user.description: kubernetes: the user ID the CronJobs run as (the image's non-root user; default 10001, the launcher image's)

serving.description: Pipewright 1.4.2: endpoints the platform's Terraform creates (FR-92) and shared deployment resource pools for model co-hosting (FR-105). Without it every use case deploys on its own endpoint and machines, as before

endpoints.description: use case -> its endpoint, created by Terraform (public or private); deploy-model deploys onto it and never creates one for a use case listed here

additionalProperties.description: One use case's endpoint, by use case name

private.description: a Private Service Connect endpoint: reachable inside the network only

network.description: the network a private endpoint is reached from

dns_zone.description: the private DNS zone for prediction.p.vertexai.goog; deploy-model writes the endpoint's record once Agent Platform has made its address

dns_project.description: the zone's project, when not the environment's

pools.description: pool name -> a shared deployment resource pool; a use case joins one with model.serving.pool

additionalProperties.description: One shared pool: the tenant it belongs to, its machine and replicas, and the one serving image every model on it uses

tenant.description: the tenant whose use cases share it (pools are per tenant)

machine.description: the machine type, for example n1-standard-4

accelerator.description: A GPU on each of the pool's machines

min_replicas.description: machines always running (a pool does not scale to zero); production keeps 2

cpu_target.description: autoscaling CPU target in percent (Google's default 60)

image.description: the one serving image every model on the pool uses: Google's prebuilt TensorFlow or PyTorch (Preview) image

network.description: the kind of endpoint it serves: a pool serves one kind

managed_by.description: ci (the default): pipewright serving pools apply, through the API with the environment's CMEK and the tenant's identity; terraform: the platform's Terraform

service_account.description: the identity its models run as (default: the tenant's runner)

resource.description: the pool's resource name, when Terraform created it

kserve.description: private-gke: KServe for use cases with model.serving.target kserve

mirror.description: image mirror in the environment's registry (serving images from elsewhere are pulled from it)

service_account.description: the Kubernetes service account model servers run as (bound to the tenant's read-only serving identity)

additionalProperties.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the tenant's InferenceServices

exposure.description: cluster: reached inside the cluster; internal_lb: also an internal load balancer in the VPC

verifier_image.description: Pipewright 1.4.1: the image of the init container that checks the approved files before a model server starts (any image with Python 3; default: the serving image)

ray.description: Ray on Vertex AI clusters for use cases' Ray steps (optional; without it: a cluster per run, the runner identity, a prebuilt image, public endpoint, small limits)

enabled.description: false: no Ray clusters in this environment (or for this tenant)

mode.description: per_run: a cluster per Ray step of a run, created and deleted by the launcher; standing (private-gke): the tenant's long-lived, autoscaling cluster (standing.address), which steps submit to

image.description: base image for use cases' Ray images (default: the prebuilt Ray on Vertex AI image)

network_attachment.description: Private Service Connect interface for clusters (private environments)

limits.description: what a use case's Ray step may ask for

max_workers.description: most worker nodes in one cluster

machines.description: machine types allowed for head and worker nodes

max_minutes.description: longest a cluster may live; cleanup removes it after this plus a grace period

standing.description: mode standing: the tenant's cluster, kept by the platform

address.description: the head's dashboard address inside the cluster

features.description: Feature tables for use cases' data.features_from (optional; without it any table the runner can read)

required.description: models in this environment must take every feature from data.features_from

online_store.description: Pipewright 1.4.2 (FR-104): the online stores this environment offers and their settings

export_readers.description: Pipewright 1.4.2: per tenant, the identities the platform lets read its Parquet export (online-export/<tenant>/), for a team's own store

types.description: the types use cases may choose (default bigtable only)

settings.description: the instance's settings as the platform YAML set them (edition, tier, availability, disk), for doctor

kms_key.description: CMEK for the lookup services the launcher creates (where an organization policy requires it)

egress.description: the lookup services' VPC egress (default PRIVATE_RANGES_ONLY); ALL_TRAFFIC where an organization policy requires it (run.allowedVPCEgress)

datasets.description: project.dataset of each feature dataset the tenant may read; feature tables elsewhere are refused

online_store.description: the tenant's Feature Store online store (Bigtable): use cases with model.serving.features online read their features from its views (Pipewright 1.1)

lookup_service_account.description: the identity of the tenant's lookup services

sync_job.description:
the tenant's Cloud Run job that syncs its online tables, projects/

/locations//jobs/
